Maria (CS): Quick heads-up - HorizonLabs onboarding is stuck: Android SDK warmup at scale is returning a lot of 429s from preflight during their CI-driven rollout. Renewal review in ~6 weeks so want minimal friction.
Kaito (HorizonLabs): Yep, reproduced locally in staging. We spin 150 emulator workers in parallel for mobile load tests. Each worker does a short init+embed call.
Arjun (Eng): Can you paste the Android init + headers and approximate peak QPS? Any token TTL things?
Kaito (HorizonLabs): Peak ~900 QPS for ~20s. Init: ```kotlin
val client = RedwoodClient.Builder(context)
  .withApiKey(BuildConfig.RW_KEY)
  .enablePrefetch(true)
  .build()
client.embed("startup-seed")
```
Kaito (HorizonLabs): Logs show `429 preflight_quota_exceeded` and some `auth: ephemeral_refresh(0s)` entries.
Arjun (Eng): Two likely contributors: (1) preflight fanout from many separate processes without preflight caching, (2) ephemeral token churn - tokens are rotating per-process. SDK can do local caching of preflight + token reuse.
Priya (Solutions): We should run a 30m enablement: checklist = reduce parallelism, add client-side splay, enable keepalive/pool, set preflight cache window, and implement graceful retries with JITTER.
Arjun (Eng): SDK guidance for Android: use `RedwoodClient.Builder().withConnectionPool(10).withPrefetchWindow(30000)` and call a shared warmup singleton per host process instead of per-emulator. For CI, add a small randomized sleep before init: `Thread.sleep(ThreadLocalRandom.current().nextInt(0,200))`.
SDK Bot: telemetry: horizonlabs-acct preflight_429_total=248 at 2026-01-14T09:12:07Z, avg_preflight_latency=62ms, token_rotation=1.5/s
Kaito (HorizonLabs): We can change our job to run 10 workers per host instead of 150 separate workers, but that requires CI reconfig. We can try a quick experiment.
Maria (CS): If they can reduce to 30 concurrent init threads and add splay/jitter, that should show immediate improvement. I'll open a support ticket to temporarily raise their preflight burst allowance for the onboarding window (acct id: hl-7721) so retries clear quicker while they adjust CI.
Ops (Support): Ticket created #SUP-18921: temp preflight burst bump requested for hl-7721. ETA response: 2h. We'll monitor metrics.
Kaito (HorizonLabs): Made the CI change to 30 concurrent in parallel group and added a 0-250ms jitter before init. Re-running warmup now.
SDK Bot: telemetry (update): preflight_429_total=9 in last 10m, avg_latency=58ms, token_rotation=0.3/s
Kaito (HorizonLabs): Huge improvement — 429s down to single digits across load test. Thanks.
Priya (Solutions): I'll share a short runbook and a trimmed quickstart snippet for Android warmups (include connection pool, prefetch window, jitter example, Retry-After handling). We should also add a note to onboarding docs about CI coldstart fanout patterns.
Arjun (Eng): Dev follow-up: we'll add an SDK safeguard that sets a sensible default connection pool and warns on `enablePrefetch(true)` when it detects high parallelism in CI environments. Filing an internal task.
Maria (CS): Closing: schedule enablement session with HorizonLabs next Tue for 30m so we can walk through runbook and make sure they won't hit renewal risks. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
Kaito (HorizonLabs): Appreciate the fast turnaround. Also logged feedback about clearer docs for mobile CI warmups.
Maria (CS): I'll escalate feedback to Docs. End of thread.
